overview: The Nicko Guerrero Trio performed a set of Colombian-inspired jazz and original compositions at the Medford Jazz Fest 2026.

items.title: Performance Introduction and Opening Songs
items.summary: Terry Carter introduced the Nicko Guerrero Trio, who opened their performance with the compositions 'Bacatá' and 'Fandango de Luna'.

items.title: Ambrosio
items.summary: Nicko Guerrero introduced the song 'Ambrosio,' which he composed to express gratitude toward a community member who hosted him during a research trip in Colombia.

items.title: El Viajero
items.summary: Following a performance of Thelonious Monk's 'What You Needed,' the trio performed 'El Viajero.'

items.title: Matato
items.summary: Guerrero introduced the final song of the set, 'Matato,' which depicts a folklore story of a fight between a fish and a bull.

items.title: Band Introductions and Closing
items.summary: Guerrero and Carter introduced the members of the trio before transitioning the stage to the Berklee Institute of Global Jazz.
